title: Payment passed to charity
hook: Two stated cases: explore the destination of a payment in cash accounting.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the destination of a payment in cash accounting affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Profit, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the destination of a payment in cash accounting in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
